statistic.pairwise: at each (n, x): pi = r11 - r10 - r01 + r00; informative where |r10-r00|+|r01-r00| > 0; material at alpha where |pi| > alpha * max(|r00|,|r10|,|r01|,|r11|)
statistic.multiway: orthonormal decomposition of r at each point; an interaction order's share of the point's centred total sum of squares > alpha

reference.source: ref_hi and ref_lo columns of each cells.csv
reference.why: these are the two halves the driver subtracts, copied from the run's reference.csv; the reference is the single 60-digit mpmath evaluation at each lane's narrowed argument
